## [The delivery was smooth however I was…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a7c89135a965508f5515e7e)
The delivery was smooth however I was disappointed that the rug pad is being delivered separately so now we will have to move the furniture again and redo the whole install once the pad arrives. Additionally, I have dogs and have had many rugs over the years and this one has already taken a real beating in less then 24 hours. My dogs have never done this to another rug before, even other flat weaves, so I would tell anyone with dogs not to purchase this rug. I don't think it is going to last 6 months in my home. I have rugs in my home that I've had for 15+ years that are in much better condition than this one is one day later.

August 7, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 12, 2026

Hi Alie,

Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience your pets have caused with the rug's quality. If you're looking for pet-friendly rug options, we are happy to assist you. Our Design services can help you find a more suitable rug, just let us know!

Lulu and Georgia
